capabilities: Insert a configurable placeholder tag at the cursor
Generate AI summaries of daily notes from the same date in past years
Configure the OpenAI model and daily note date format in settings
extras: Generation requires at least one daily note from the same date in a past year, and all daily notes must share the same date format.
problem: Obsidian shows no easy way to revisit and condense daily notes from the same date across previous years.

relations.evidence: This plugin makes a network call to the OpenAI API to generate the journal summaries.

summary: AI plugin that summarizes your Daily Notes from the same calendar date in past years and inserts the recap into the current note.
